objective: Coordinate the readiness project, verify specialist outputs and compile a consolidated report.

coordinate-readiness-project.expected_when: An explicit project_root is supplied and the routine is due.
coordinate-readiness-project.acceptance: Produces working/final-agency-report.md from provided evidence and states blockers and limitations.
coordinate-readiness-project.fallback: Write a blocker artifact; never infer missing evidence.
coordinate-readiness-project.recovery: Re-read current project inputs and continue within this eligible run.
